'''June 2000 Sacramento tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Florin Rd Mall, Sacramento, CA on 10 June 2000. [[Paul Todd Feldman]] won it. It is known from Clayton Atkin's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d871">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-11-sacramento-ca-6-10-00d871/ sacramento-ca-6-10-00], DeckTech (Clayton "TheDohMan" Atkin, 11 June 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-11-sacramento-ca-6-10-00d871/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 10 June 2000
* '''Site:''' Florin Rd Mall, Sacramento, CA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Paul Todd Feldman]]
